sentence_stem: What the team really needed was
correct_completion: a clearer plan before the deadline.
full_sentence: What the team really needed was a clearer plan before the deadline.
acceptable_variants: a more detailed plan before the deadline.

options.text: they had already decided against it.
options.why_wrong: This is a complete clause about a past decision. A cleft sentence after 'was' needs a phrase that names what the team needed, so this option breaks the structure.
'So' introduces a result, not the thing that was needed. The cleft focus after 'was' must name the need itself.

options.text: a clearer plan before the deadline.
the plan was not clear at all.
options.why_wrong: This is a full sentence with its own finite verb, so it cannot complete the cleft after 'was'. It describes the plan instead of naming what was needed.

explanation: A pseudo-cleft sentence places the focus after 'was'. The completion must be a noun phrase that names what the team needed. Learners often add a full clause after 'was', which creates an ungrammatical structure.
translation: O que a equipe realmente precisava era de um plano mais claro antes do prazo final.
